question: Select the sentences that contains no spelling errors.

options.text: My mother asked me to purchase two bread knives having serrated edges.
My mother asked me to purchase two bread knives having seerated edges.
My mother asked me to purchase two bread knives having serratted edges.
My mother asked me to purchase two bread knives having serated edges.

solution:
The correct answer is **My mother asked me to purchase two bread knives having serrated edges.**
